# Construction and condition fixtures

Synthetic development cases exercise five existing rule families through the
CLI, with exact source locations under BOM, CRLF, emphasis and protected code.
The examples retain actual retry conditions and distinguish a prose notice from
an audit-log requirement, a method from an actor, and a repeated definition from
a qualified technical relation. Explicit forbid settings test CLI exit behavior;
these constructions remain experimental warnings in the built-in profiles.
